sections.text:
This document
 outlines the maintenance procedure P1 of main steam stop valve, 
 depended on external or internal leakage. This valve is used for isolate main 
 steam (90 bar, 520 ْ
 C)

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Gamal Elsyed Osily, reviewed by maintenance manger eng. Sobhey Abdel Haleem, revised by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control general director, and approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel Ghaffar Al-Arish 
 PS general manager.

This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC planning & financial 
predicting head sector and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.

items: A work permit must be issued

The maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks to surround the work area.

Wear 
 the safety and healthy equipment as: safety 
 helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs .... etc
Isolate the valve electrically and mechanically
Drain the pipeline, which connected of valve.

Complete 
 maintenance tool set.

Cleaning 
 fluid.

Suitable 
 lifting device
Lapping tools and grinding compound.
Check for any leakage from valve gland, retighten on bolts.
Check for any internal leakage.
Check for any leakage from valve bodies.
Be sure the pressure in boiler reach to zero
Drain the main steam line by opening drain valves before and after valve.
Prior to disassembling, open the valve more than 1/3 of total left.

Remove the actuator bolts (12), and retighten the gland packing, and then lock 
 the stem (05).

Turn the actuator handle clock wise and disengage the actuator (7) from the 
 stem (5), and then hang it with rope from the ceiling.

Take out the yoke clamp, and disengage the yoke (11) from the body (1) then 
 hang it with rope from the ceiling
Loosen the nuts (15) on the bonnet bolts (14) at this point.

Hit lightly on the upper rim of the retaining ring (6) so as to loosen it 
 counter clock wise, then take away the retaining ring from the bolt, and 
 remove the seal ring (8).

Disengage the combination block comprising the stem(5), disc (3) and bonnet 
 (2) etc. from the body (1). In this case the care should be taken to avoid 
 damage to contact surface. And identification marks on the body and disc 
 should be checked to avoid misplacing of the disc in reassembling.
Remove the eye bolts (13) and eye bolts clamp.
Respective parts should be checked carefully, especially for :

Wearing of the disc and seat surface, the lapping of the disc and seat, where 
 necessary may be carried out by using lapping tools and compound.
Hardening of the gland packing due to fatigue and renew it if needed.

Wearing of the seal ring and the opposite surface of contact, repair or renew 
 the seal ring.
Wearing of the stem where it rope against the gland packing in the stem
Wearing of the back seat.
Clean every part well.

Supply the graphite compound for respective threaded parts of the bonnet and 
 eye bolts to prevent the seizure
Assembly the valve parts in reverse sequence of disassembly.

Reassembly of the valve
